COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No. 60 of 2026
Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Anil Anthwal, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
2. Mr. Pradeep Hairiya, learned Standing
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Neeraj Garg, learned counsel for
respondent no.3/UPNL.
4. Brief facts of the case are that the
petitioner was engaged in the Labour
Department as Data Entry Operator in the
year 2019-2020 through respondent no. 3-
UPNL. Since, the regular incumbents, against
whose vacancies the petitioner was engaged,
joined back, therefore, the petitioner was
disengaged from the Labour Department and
was sent back to UPNL vide order dated
01.08.2024.
5. The grievance of the petitioner is that
after his disengagement, he has not been
engaged in any other department by the
UPNL. Petitioner has already filed a
representation in this regard on 09.12.2025.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that he may be permitted to file a
fresh detailed representation before
respondent no. 3.
7. Learned counsel for respondent no.3-
UPNL, on the other hand, submits that if
petitioner makes a fresh representation in this
regard, the same shall be examined by the
competent authority.
8. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed

of with liberty to the petitioner to make a
fresh detailed representation to respondent
no.3 within a period of three weeks from
today. If petitioner makes such a
representation, the respondent no. 3 shall
decide the same within four weeks from the
date of receipt of such representation, taking
a sympathetic view.
 (Alok Mahra J.) 08.01.2026
Ujjwal
